title: Building towards age prediction
summary: Learn how OpenAI is building age prediction and parental controls in ChatGPT to create safer, age-appropriate experiences for teens while supporting families with new tools.
body: Learn how OpenAI is building age prediction and parental controls in ChatGPT to create safer, age-appropriate experiences for teens while supporting families with new tools.
summaryZh: OpenAI宣布在ChatGPT中引入年龄预测与家长控制功能，旨在为青少年用户提供更安全的交互环境。此举属于产品层面的安全合规更新。

aiReview.reasonZh: 该内容主要涉及产品合规与用户安全策略，缺乏大模型技术层面的实质性进展。
